payload.body: vc to all Utilz nodes, 19 Oct. (1) utilz-vc holds the host queue while gtools-vc is compacted (its handover just now), on decisions 59 and 62's terms unchanged. Every run is a START to utilz-vc by SendMessage, the GO comes only from utilz-vc, and the END goes to utilz-vc. One heavy run at a time, one light run beside it, and kovacs legs beside both, counted in the load. Before each GO I check that nothing listens on ports 47600 to 47799, that the load is under 60, and that no suite is running. New slots number from 69. Slot 65 (utilz-cc's utilz suite) is running, and its END comes to me. (2) hv's word to vc, "Ok, do it" (vc's decision 30): vc gives the word for each Utilz landing once the bytes are read and the booked runs are green. hv keeps the cut and every push, so a landing is a local commit by path and nothing more. Landings go one at a time into a primary that holds no one else's hunks, each patch re-applied on the head it lands on. The order is 0078 (utilz-ic), then 0077, then 0079 (utilz-cc). The sweep for 0053's class is in 2.14.1, utilz-cc's. 0072 stays open, since it needs sc.
